style: Illustration in the style of a Japanese comic essay about family life (the kind of warm, slightly humorous everyday manga popular on Instagram): clean, confident dark-brown line art, flat soft colors with very light cel shading, warm pastel palette (cream, peach, mustard, sage green, dusty blue), simple but very expressive faces, cozy and realistic Japanese apartment details. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not chibi, no heavy screentone. Original characters: do not imitate any existing manga, anime, brand or real person. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, signs, labels, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering or watermarks anywhere in the image.
characters: WIFE (SHINOBU, the main character, always exactly the same person): Japanese woman, 44 years old, average slim build, dark brown hair tied in a loose low bun with a few loose strands, side-swept bangs, small gold stud earrings, natural makeup, a mustard-yellow knit cardigan over a plain white T-shirt, light grey wide trousers; she often holds a small black notebook and a pen. HUSBAND (MAMORU): Japanese man, 46 years old, slightly chubby, short slightly messy black hair with ONE distinctive upright cowlick tuft sticking straight up from the top of his head (his signature), black rectangular glasses, navy hoodie, beige chinos, usually holding a smartphone, a carefree, self-satisfied face. SON (MINATO): Japanese boy, 9 years old, short black hair, calm and sharp eyes, red-and-white horizontal striped T-shirt, navy shorts. MOTHER-IN-LAW (YOSHIE, the husband's mother): Japanese woman in her early 70s, short permed grey hair, small round gold-rimmed glasses, lavender cardigan, a pearl necklace, a cheerful but thoughtless face. BABY: a newborn wrapped in a plain white blanket.
vertical: Vertical 9:16 full-bleed illustration that fills the entire canvas edge to edge: no borders, no frames, no panel lines, no blank margins and no flat color bands at the top or bottom. Keep the top eighth of the picture calm (a plain wall or ceiling that is part of the scene), because a title will be placed there. Faces must be large, clear and well inside the frame, roughly between 22% and 50% of the height and away from the edges; the lower part of the picture (below about 55%) should hold bodies, furniture or the floor, because big captions will cover it.

scenes.prompt: The family kitchen in the morning. The refrigerator door is completely covered with reminders: a big wall calendar with one date circled in red, several large sticky notes and a sheet of paper, all showing only scribbled lines and simple doodle icons (absolutely no readable letters or numbers). The HUSBAND, in a white business shirt and tie, with his black rectangular glasses and his upright cowlick, stands in front of the fridge with both palms up and his shoulders raised in an innocent shrug, mouth open as if claiming he never heard anything. The WIFE stands beside the fridge, pointing firmly at the circled calendar date with one finger, with a cold, flat, unimpressed face. Both faces large and clear in the upper-middle of the picture.
